notes: The only names are a variant remark: «قال أبو عمير في حديثه» gives Abu Umayr's version of the same saying, so the group is marked variant and is not a route.
The text writes no route for the saying itself apart from this remark; the reading is thin on purpose.
«قال ابن ماجه هذا حديث الرمليين» is the compiler's own comment, not a link.
